cases.summary: Online "sweetheart" brags about 300% a month and asks for a USDT deposit ("pig butchering")

input.visibleText: Sweetheart, my uncle showed me a trading platform. I made 300% this month. Open an account at trade-gold-pro.example and deposit $5,000 in USDT so we can build our future.

reasons.explanation: It mentions gift cards, wire transfers, or crypto. Scammers ask for these because the money can't be gotten back.
It promises guaranteed, risk-free, or very large profits. Real investments never guarantee profits; promises like this are how investment scams pull people in.
It sells an investment with big promises or a famous name AND asks you to put money in. Together, this is how investment scams work. Talk to someone you trust before investing.
It asks you to put money in, often in crypto, to start trading or investing.

cases.why: Impossible profits plus a crypto deposit: the end stage of a romance investment scam.
